record.question: First IT Park was inaugurated by President Pranab Mukherjee in which state?
record.explanation: Kerala, option B. The intended event was the inauguration of UL CyberPark in Kozhikode on 27 February 2016. The President of India’s dated address identifies it as the first IT park in the Malabar region and the first developed by a labour cooperative. The question’s bare “First IT Park” wording is broader than that event and should not be read as claiming it was India’s first-ever IT park. Primary reference: https://www.presidentofindia.gov.in/shri-pranab-mukherjee/speeches/address-president-india-shri-pranab-mukherjee-occasion-8 Verified worked solution; unofficial.
